title: Elon Musk Says ‘Yikes’ As CoreWeave Bond Yield Hits 15% Amid Chamath Palihapitiya’s ‘Private Credit Bubbl
key_facts: CoreWeave (CRWV) stock fell about 15% on Wednesday 14 October, its lowest close since 29 July.
On Tuesday Chamath Palihapitiya posted a chart showing the yield on $1.25 billion of CoreWeave bonds due 2032 touched 15% and closed at 14.5%.
Bloomberg, citing an internal memo, reports chief executive Mike Intrator said the market is acting 'irrationally'.
CoreWeave's total debt reached about $52 billion at the end of June, up from about $15 billion a year earlier.
quote_evidence: "When you are building a new type of technology company, there will be periods of time when the market misunderstands and acts irrationally," CEO Mike Intrator wrote to staff.
Musk, who owns the platform, replied with one word: "Yikes."
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how AI-buildout debt costs are being read by investors and public figures.
notes: Benzinga page blocked (Cloudflare). Read Yahoo Finance's own report of the same story. Reply story: Musk replied to Palihapitiya's post of Tuesday 13 October.
